scripts.typecheck: pnpm run types:gen && if [ -d ui ]; then pnpm --dir ui run typecheck; fi && if [ -d api ]; then pnpm --dir api run typecheck; fi && if [ -d plugins ]; then for dir in plugins/*; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then pnpm --dir "$dir" --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --dir "$dir" --if-present run typecheck:ui; fi; done; fi
scripts.test: pnpm --dir api --if-present run test && pnpm --dir ui --if-present run test && if [ -d plugins ]; then for d in plugins/*; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then pnpm --dir "$d" --if-present run test; fi; done; fi
scripts.test:db:reset: docker compose rm -fsv postgres-api-test postgres-auth-test && docker compose up -d --wait postgres-api-test postgres-auth-test
scripts.test:regression:browser:dev:ssr: node tests/regression/lib/preflight.mjs && REGRESSION_MODE=dev:ssr pnpm exec playwright test -c tests/regression/browser/playwright.config.mjs --project=dev:ssr
scripts.test:regression:browser:dev:csr: node tests/regression/lib/preflight.mjs && REGRESSION_MODE=dev:csr pnpm exec playwright test -c tests/regression/browser/playwright.config.mjs --project=dev:csr
scripts.test:regression:browser:all: pnpm run test:regression:browser:dev:ssr && pnpm run test:regression:browser:dev:csr
